rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a gun-related shooting incident, especially a reported or criminal case.

example.english: There was a shooting in the United States last night.
example.traditional: 尋晚美國發生咗一宗槍擊案。
example.jyutping: cam4 maan5 mei5 gwok3 faat3 sang1 zo2 jat1 zung1 coeng1 gik1 on3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the sport or organized activity of firing weapons, not for an individual gunfire incident.

example.english: This Sunday, we are going to the shooting range to practise shooting.
example.traditional: 今個星期日我哋去射擊場練習射擊。
example.jyutping: gam1 go3 sing1 kei4 jat6 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 se6 gik1 coeng4 lin6 zaap6 se6 gik1

rows.note: Use this for a sudden darting or stabbing sensation of pain, such as in the head.

example.english: I suddenly felt a shooting pain in my head just now.
example.traditional: 頭先我個頭突然有一陣刺痛。
example.jyutping: tau4 sin1 ngo5 go3 tau4 dat6 jin4 jau5 jat1 zan6 ci3 tung3
